cards.question: What lung-protective tidal volume should I set in ARDS?
cards.answer: Use 6 mL/kg predicted body weight (ARDSNet), aiming for a plateau pressure ≤30 cmH₂O and driving pressure ≤15 cmH₂O; permit hypercapnia provided pH ≥7.20.

cards.question: How do I choose PEEP in moderate–severe ARDS?
cards.answer: Titrate to the lowest FiO₂ that achieves SpO₂ 88–95%, using a higher-PEEP/FiO₂ table (ALVEOLI) or oesophageal pressure-guided titration; reassess driving pressure after each step.

cards.question: When should I switch from volume to pressure control?
cards.answer: Consider pressure control when peak–plateau gradient is high, there is patient–ventilator asynchrony, or in paediatrics/leak around the tube — it delivers a decelerating flow that may improve distribution but tidal volume becomes compliance-dependent.
